snippet.title: Shmup! Before vs Now
snippet.description:
From simple placeholder shapes and programmer art… to hand-drawn enemies, effects, and full arcade chaos 🚀

This video shows the evolution of my indie shmup from an early alpha prototype to the current version in development.

The first footage shows the game during its earliest stages, where the focus was purely on gameplay systems, movement, shooting, enemy behaviour, and core mechanics.

The later footage shows how the project has evolved with:
• hand-drawn visuals
• updated enemies and bosses
• improved VFX and explosions
• overall gameplay refinement

It’s been awesome seeing the transformation from “just make it playable” into something that finally feels like a real game.

If you enjoy classic arcade shooters, bullet hells, or indie shmups inspired by old-school action games, feel free to follow along with development.

Thanks for watching!

#gamedev #indiedev #shmup #bullethell #arcadegames #unity3d
